GREEN: (1) runtime_use verdict carried on Fact/EngineFact from extraction per TDD S1-05 (value_position via T12's collect_identifier_usage; dynamic for require()/import() by construction; serde-default None keeps old facts conservative); (2) nested_type_identifier + type_query identifiers now TYPE uses, so `type Row = T.X` / `keyof typeof T` no longer count as value use; (3) resolve_import_symbol follows flattening export-* chains (BFS declaration order, cycle-safe) to the DECLARING file - IMPORT_RESOLVES_TO_SYMBOL now points there; a chain through an external/unresolvable star target marks the export set open and silences unresolved_import_symbol (absence unprovable); (4) `export * as ns` emits ExportedSymbol(ns) and is excluded from the chain map (namespace, not flattening); (5) diagnostics strictly narrowed: unresolved_import_symbol needs direct+chain miss AND closed chain AND not-dynamic; unsupported_namespace_import_symbol only when no runtime use provable. stream_graph's superseded pin (diagnostic expected on a VALUE-USED namespace binding) updated to the new intended behaviour.
